domain_pddl:
(define (domain iw-novelty-pruning)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates (start) (p) (q) (r) (shared) (progress) (goal))
  (:action root-a
    :parameters ()
    :precondition (and (start) (p))
    :effect (and (shared) (not (start)) (not (p))))
  (:action root-b
    :parameters ()
    :precondition (and (start) (q))
    :effect (and (shared) (not (start)) (not (q))))
  (:action root-c
    :parameters ()
    :precondition (and (start) (r))
    :effect (and (shared) (not (start)) (not (r))))
  (:action continue
    :parameters ()
    :precondition (and (shared) (q) (r))
    :effect (and (progress) (not (shared))))
  (:action finish
    :parameters ()
    :precondition (progress)
    :effect (goal)))
